content: Yesuusi Philaxoosa Sinthan
Wonta guura ellesidi kahine halaqati, cimati, higge astamaaretinne Ayhude shangoti ubbay shiiqidi maqetidosona. Enti Yesuusa qachi efidi Philaxoosas aathidi immidosona.
Philaxoosi iyako, “Neeni Ayhude kawo?” yaagidi oychis. Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ne gadasa” yaagis.
Kahine halaqati Yesuusa daroban mootidosona.
Shin Philaxoosi zaaridi Yesuusako, “New zaariyabay baawee? Enti ne bolla ay mela mootuwa ehiyako be7ikii?” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi haraba zaaronna ixin, Philaxoosi malaaletis.
Yesuusi Hayqo Pirdetis
Philaxoosas Paasika Ba7aale bonchiya gallasan asay koya issi asi qashope billiya meezey de7ees.
He wode issi Barbaana geetetiya uray ooshshu kessidi shempo wodhida asaara issife qasho keethan de7ees.
Shiiqida daro asay Philaxoosi kaseysada oothana mela iya oychidosona.
Philaxoosi asa zaaridi, “Taani hintew Ayhudeta kawa billanaysa koyeetii?” yaagidi oychis.
Hessa I giday, kahine halaqati Yesuusa qanaatidi aathidi immidaysa eriya gishosa.
Shin kahine halaqati Yesuusa gisho Barbaana billanaada, he shiiqida asay Philaxoosa woossana mela asaa maqidosona.
Philaxoosi zaaridi, “Yaatin, ha hinte Ayhude kawo geysa waato?” yaagis.
Asay Philaxoosa bolla waassidi, “Masqale bolla iya kaqa” yaagidosona.
Philaxoosi, “Ayis? I ay iitaba oothidee?” yaagis. Shin asay kaseysafe guji waassidi, “Masqale bolla iya kaqa” yaagidosona.
Philaxoosi asaa ufaysanaw koyidi, Barbaana billis. Yaatidi, lisson Yesuusa garaafisidi, masqaliya bolla kaqana mela entaw aathidi immis.
Yesuusi Tooshetis
Hessafe guye, wotaadareti Yesuusa deriya haareysa ooso keethi efidi, hara wotaadareta ubbaa issife xeegidosona.
Qassi zo7o afila iya mayzidosona; aguntha kallacha giigisidi, iya huuphen wothidosona.
Hessafe guye, iyako, “Ayhudeta kawaw merinaw kawota” yaagidi, iyaw ziggidosona.
Iya huuphiya xam7an shocidosona; qassi iya bolla cuttidosona; gulbatidi iyaw goyinnidosona.
Iya toochidaape guye zo7o afila iyape qaari ekidi, iya afila iya mayzidi masqale bolla iya kaqanaw efidosona.
Yesuusi Kaqetis
Enti bishe, Iskindirenne Rufoosa aawa, Simoona geetetiya Qereena biitta asi, gaxarepe katama yeysara gahetidi, Yesuusa masqaliya wolqan toossidosona.
Yaatidi Golgota geetetiya bessaa Yesuusa efidosona. “Golgota” guussay “Huuphe guugge” guussu.
Sakoy si7etonna mela karbera walaketida woyne uyo gidi iyaw immidosona; shin I uyonna ixis.
Enti masqale bolla iya kaqidosona. Oona aybi gakaneeko gidi iya afila shaakidi saama yeggidosona.
Enti masqale bolla iya kaqiya wode wontafe heedzu saate.
Enti, “Ayhude kawa” yaagidi iya mootiya xuufe xaafidi wothidosona.
Yesuusara nam7u pangata issuwa iyape ushacha baggara hankuwa iyape haddirsa baggara masqale bolla kaqidosona.
Geeshsha Maxaafay, “Iitabaa oothida asatara I paydetis” geetetidaysi poletis.
Ogera aadhiya asay Yesuusa kadhidi, banta huuphiya qaathidi cayidosona. “Heko! Xoossa Keetha laallada heedzu gallasa giddon keexana geyso,
ane masqaliya bollafe wodha; ne huuphiya ashsha” yaagidosona.
Hessadaka, kahine halaqati higge asatamaaretara issife Yesuusa toochidi, “Harata ashshis, shin bana ashshanaw danda7enna;
nuuni be7idi ammanana mela Kiristoosi, Isra7eele Kawoy, ane masqale bollafe ha77i wodho” yaagidosona. Qassi hari attoshin, iyara masqale bolla kaqetidaysatika iya toochidosona.
Yesuusa Hayquwa
Usupun saatepe doomidi, uddufun saate gakanaw biitta ubbay dhumis.
Uddufun saaten Yesuusi, “Elohe, Elohe, lama sabaqtanii?” yaagidi waassis. Hessa guussay, “Ta Xoossaw, ta Xoossaw, tana ayis aggadii?” guussu.
Hessan eqida asape issoy issoy hessa si7idi, “Heko, Eeliyaasa xeegees” yaagis.
He asape issoy woxidi, isponjen caala woyne kunthis; hessa xam7a xeeran wothidi, “Naagite; Eeliyaasi masqale bollafe iya wodhisanaw yaaneko ane be7oos” yaagidi, Yesuusa doonako ushshanaw shiishis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi waassis; hayqis.
Xoossa keethan kaqetida magaraajoy qommofe duge gakanaw, nam7u keyidi daaketi wodhis.
Masqaliyape sintha baggara yan eqida issi mato halaqay, Yesuusi waanidi hayqidaako be7ida wode, “Ha uray tuma Xoossa Na7a” yaagis.
Hessa haahon eqidi be7iya guutha maccasati de7oosona. Enta giddon Magdela Mayraama, kaaluwa Yayqoobanne Yoosa aayiya Mayraamanne Salooma de7oosona.
He maccasati Yesuusi Galilan de7iya wode iya kaallidaysatanne iya mokidaysata qassi Yesuusara issife Yerusalaame bida hara daro maccasati yan de7oosona.
Yesuusi Moogetis

Sa7i omarsida wode, shiiqida asan bonchetida Ayhude shangotape issoy, Yoosefa geetetiya uray, Xoossa kawotethay yaanaysa naagishe de7eysi, Armaate katama asi de7eysi yis. Wontethe Sambaatas giigetiya gallas gidida gisho, Yoosefi minnidi Philaxoosako bidi, Yesuusa aha ekanaw woossis.
Philaxoosi, Yesuusi hayqidaysa si7ida wode malaaletis; mato halaqa xeegidi, “I hayqidi gam7idee?” yaagidi oychis.
Philaxoosi, Yesuusi hayqidaysa mato halaqaape si7idi, iya aha Yoosefas immis.
Yoosefi moogo afila shammis; Yesuusa aha masqaliyape wothidi, afilan xaaxidi, shuchafe woocetida duufon iya aha moogis. Qassi he duufuwa doonan gita shuchu gondorsidi wothis.
Magdela Mayraamanne Yoosa aayiya Mayraama Yesuusa aha enti awun moogidako be7oosona.
